title: Disable Network Throttling
name: network-throttling-off
modal: This removes the Windows cap on network throughput for games and multimedia.
description: Removes Windows network throughput cap for lower ping and faster packets in games
deepDescription:
Windows throttles non-multimedia network traffic to 10 packets per millisecond. This removes the cap entirely:

- NetworkThrottlingIndex → Unlimited

Revert restores the default of 10.
